note: both qubits idle at their own double sweet spots (first-order flux-insensitive); QF2 leaves its sweet spot only during the 6.6 ns resonant exchange pulse
verdict: Simulated Bell pair between two independently addressed quantum-fluxon (Josephson-vortex) qubits of the QFX-1 design. Prior art: single vortex qubits (KIT 2023; grAl vortex qubits, Nambisan et al. Nature 2026 with estimated 10-100 MHz vortex-vortex coupling); an addressable entangled two-vortex processor was not found in the searched literature. T1 values are assumptions bracketing the reported range.
